0022600164.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, winners of three straight) host the Sacramento Kings (0-5, losers of five straight), with Dallas 3rd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 7th in the West while Sacramento sit 15th in the West. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Dallas lost 1-2 to Sacramento in the 2025-26 season, including a 130-121 home loss on February 26, 2026.
